item.title: Top Pick: Subway: BOGO 50% Off Footlongs with Code BOGO50
item.guid: Subway-BOGO 50% Off Footlongs with Code BOGO50-2026-10-24

item.description: El Pollo Loco's value combos (Original Pollo Bowl, Classic Chicken Burrito, 3 Tacos al Carbon) come with chips and a regular drink for $5.99 to $6.99 at a Los Angeles store on order.elpolloloco.com, checked October 3, 2026. item.title: Publix: Sub of the Week: $2 Off This Week's Featured Whole Sub
item.guid: Publix-Sub of the Week: $2 Off This Week's -2026-10-24
item.description: Every week Publix takes $2 off one featured whole deli sub (a Boar's Head turkey sub or the Publix Deli Ultimate Sub, for example, about $8.99 instead of $10.99), fully customizable at the counter, online or in the app. The featured sub changes with the weekly ad; the deli's weekly specials page lists it. (FL & Southeast only) (Ongoing (changes weekly))
